    )
    session.freeze()
    pool.clear_for_preparation()
    torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    release_unused()
    if group is not None:
        torch.distributed.barrier(group=group)
    free, total = torch.cuda.mem_get_info(device)
    frontend = Path(__file__).parent / "assets"
    assets = {
        role: {"path": str(path), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
        for role, path in (
            ("tokenizer", metadata_path / "tokenizer.json"),
        )
    }
    buffers["request_pending_token"] = requests.pending_token
    server_config = {
        "identity": identity,
        "model_id": snapshot.name,
        "max_sequence_tokens": config.context,
        "prefill_chunk_size": config.prefill_chunk_size,
        "pages": pages,
        "state_rows": state_rows,

        "page_tokens": PAGE_TOKENS,
        "frontend": prepare_frontend(metadata_path, eos_token_ids=[1], prompt_encoder=PromptEncoder.DEEPSEEK_V4, image_profile="deepseek4",
            preprocessor=frontend / "preprocessor_config.json"),
        "sampling_defaults": RECIPE.sampling_defaults.as_dict(),
        "assets": assets,
        "model_contract": prepare_contract(signatures, buffers, pool, image_slots=config.image_concurrency, page_tokens=PAGE_TOKENS, draft_lag=0 if config.dspark else None, rows=None),
    }
    memory = {
        "rank": rank,
        "world_size": shard.world_size,
        "device": config.devices[rank],
        "weights_bytes": weights.allocated_bytes,
        "mapped_host_bytes": 0,
        "offloaded_bytes": 0,
        "continuation_bytes": pool.backing.nbytes,
        "preparation_state_rows": int(pool.memory_capacity[0].item()),
        "preparation_state_bytes": int(pool.memory_capacity[0].item()) * layout.row_bytes,
        "state_rows": state_rows,
        "pages": pages,
        "page_bytes": bytes_per_page,
        "page_tokens": PAGE_TOKENS,
        "kv_bytes": pages * bytes_per_page,
        "completion_output_bytes": completion.nbytes, "operator_scratch_bytes": arena.nbytes,
        "graphs": len(graphs),
        "prefill_capacities": config.prefill_capacities,
        "free_device_bytes": free,
        "total_device_bytes": total,
        "headroom_bytes": config.headroom_bytes,
        "allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.memory_allocated(device),
        "reserved_bytes": torch.cuda.memory_reserved(device),
        "tuning": tuning,
        "compiled_decoder": config.compile_decoder,
    }
    if config.dspark:
        server_config.update(
            speculative_widths=config.speculative_widths,
            speculative_token_capacity=speculative_token_capacity(config.max_active, max(config.speculative_widths), config.speculative_token_capacity),
            speculative_fixed_width=config.speculative_fixed_width,
        )
        memory.update(speculative_shapes=config.speculative_shapes)
    disposable = [
        prefill_storage,
        decoder_storage,
        arena.tensor,
        metadata,
        vision_storage,
        vision_state.arena,
        graph_buffers.chunks,

        disposable.append(speculation.sampling_buffers.chunks)
    for forward in forwards.values():
        if hasattr(forward, "completion") and hasattr(forward.completion, "scratch_tensors"):
            disposable.append(forward.completion.scratch_tensors)
    return PreparedModel(
        device=config.devices[rank],
        graphs=graphs,
        buffers=buffers,
        signatures=signatures,
        max_active=config.max_active,
        session=session,
        server_config=server_config,
        memory_report=memory,
        export_zero_ranges=(*storage_ranges(disposable), *completion.zero_ranges()),
        resources=(
            weights,
            vision_state,
            vision_inputs,
            vision_prefill,
            vision_storage,
            graph_buffers,
            pool,
            requests,
            inputs,
            admission,
            commands,
            arena,
            forwards,
            prefill_storage,
            decoder_storage,
            scratch,
            metadata,
            compiled,
            stream,
            graph_pool,
            session,
            collective,
            prefill_collective,
            vocabulary_collective,
            markov_collective,
            coordinator,
            speculation,
        ),
        close_resources=tuple(
            c
            for c in (markov_collective, prefill_collective, vocabulary_collective, collective)
            if c is not None
        ),
    )

# Most rows of one all-reduce; larger prefill reductions run in chunks of this many rows.
REDUCE_ROWS = 1024


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PreparationConfig:
    image_concurrency: int | None = None
    compile_workers: int | None = None
    tuning_replica: TuningReplica | None = None
    devices: tuple[int, ...] = tuple(range(16))
    context: int = 1048576
    prefill_chunk_size: int = 4096
    max_active: int = 4
    snapshot_budget_bytes: int = 4 << 30
    headroom_bytes: int = 4 << 30
    compile_decoder: bool = True
    retain_graphs: bool = False
    kernel_cache: Path | None = None
    # Red Hat DSpark checkpoint, either external or in the target's dspark directory.
    draft_checkpoint: Path | None = None
    # Verification widths count the pending input and up to seven drafts.
    speculative_widths: tuple[int, ...] = tuple(range(1, 9))
    speculative_fixed_width: int | None = None
    speculative_token_capacity: int | None = None
    # Store eligible attention, shared-expert, latent MoE, and DSpark projections as MXFP8.
    online_mxfp8: bool = False
    # Shared experts overlap routing and routed experts on an auxiliary stream.
    stream_overlap: bool = True
    # Ranks share each page's context (decode context parallel over every rank, KV interleave 1).
    context_parallel: bool = True
    # The MoonViT encoder and its graphs prepare beside the text model unless the plan serves text only.
    vision: bool = True

    def __post_init__(self):
        from ignition.components.capacity import image_capacity

        object.__setattr__(self, "image_concurrency", image_capacity(self.max_active, self.image_concurrency))
        if len(self.devices) != 16 or len(set(self.devices)) != 16 or any(d < 0 for d in self.devices):
            raise ValueError("Kimi K3 preparation requires sixteen distinct GPUs")
        request_capacity(self.max_active)
        if self.drafting:
            if not self.speculative_widths or not set(self.speculative_widths) <= set(range(1, 9)):
                raise ValueError("Kimi K3 drafts verify one through eight rows per request")
            if self.speculative_fixed_width is not None and self.speculative_fixed_width not in self.speculative_widths:
                raise ValueError("fixed verification width must belong to the captured widths")
            _ = self.speculative_shapes
        if not self.page_tokens <= self.context <= 1048576 or self.context % self.page_tokens:
            raise ValueError(f"Kimi K3 context must be {self.page_tokens}-aligned in [{self.page_tokens},1048576]")
        if not 128 <= self.prefill_chunk_size <= self.context or self.prefill_chunk_size % 128:
            raise ValueError("Kimi K3 prefill chunk must be 128-aligned and fit the context")
        if self.snapshot_budget_bytes <= 0 or self.headroom_bytes < 0:
            raise ValueError("snapshot budget must be positive and headroom nonnegative")

    @property
    def drafting(self):
        return self.draft_checkpoint is not None

    @property
    def page_tokens(self):
        """Global positions per KV page: PAGE_TOKENS local records on each rank that shares the context."""
        return PAGE_TOKENS * (len(self.devices) if self.context_parallel else 1)

    @property
    def preparation_pages(self):
        """Back one prefill chunk and two boundary pages per request row."""
        return -(-self.prefill_chunk_size // self.page_tokens) + 2 * request_capacity(self.max_active)

    @property
    def speculative_shapes(self):
        return (speculative_shapes(self.max_active, self.speculative_widths, self.speculative_token_capacity)
                if self.drafting else ())

    @property
    def decode_tokens(self):
        return max((b * w for b, w in self.speculative_shapes), default=request_capacity(self.max_active))

    @property
    def draft_tokens(self):
        return max(self.speculative_widths) - 1 if self.drafting else 0


@torch.no_grad()
def prepare_rank(snapshot, config, *, rank, group, progress=None, package_storage):
    from .recipe import RECIPE

    snapshot = Path(snapshot).resolve()
    shard = TensorParallelShard(rank, len(config.devices))
    device = torch.device("cuda", config.devices[rank])
    torch.cuda.set_device(device)
    with phase(progress, "Inspect checkpoint"):
        manifest = inspect_indexed_checkpoint(snapshot)
        headers = [shard.header_sha256 for shard in manifest.shards]
    with package_storage.transient():
        peers = None if group is None or package_storage.peer_storage is None else (group, package_storage.peer_storage)
        weights = ModelWeights.load(manifest, device, shard=shard, progress=progress, online_mxfp8=config.online_mxfp8,
                                    draft_checkpoint=config.draft_checkpoint, peers=peers,
                                    vision=config.vision)
        del manifest
        release_unused()
    transient = contextlib.ExitStack()
    transient.enter_context(package_storage.transient())
    layout = continuation_layout(weights.config, shard.world_size, speculative_tokens=config.draft_tokens)
    snapshots = layout.snapshot_capacity(config.snapshot_budget_bytes)
    if snapshots < 1:
        raise ValueError("snapshot budget must hold a complete Kimi K3 continuation")
    slots, blocks = request_capacity(config.max_active), config.context // config.page_tokens
    drafting = weights.draft is not None
    max_tokens = max(config.prefill_chunk_size, config.decode_tokens)
    state_rows = slots + snapshots
    pages = config.preparation_pages
    total_memory = minimum_across_ranks(torch.cuda.mem_get_info(device)[1], group)
    with phase(progress, "Allocate model state"):
        pool = ContinuationPool.for_model(weights.config, shard.world_size, state_rows + 1, pages, device,
            speculative_tokens=config.draft_tokens, storage=package_storage,
            maximum_pages=total_memory // page_bytes(weights.config),
            maximum_rows=total_memory // layout.row_bytes, backed_slots=min(state_rows + 1, 1 + 2 * slots))
        vocabulary = weights.config.vocabulary
        requests = DeviceRequestState.allocate(device, vocab_size=vocabulary, capacity=slots)
        inputs = BatchInputs.allocate(max_tokens, blocks, device, capacity=slots)
        admission = AdmissionBuffers.allocate(device, vocab_size=vocabulary, capacity=slots)
        commands = StateCommands.allocate(device, capacity=slots)
        frame = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
        sequence = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
        completion = CompletionOutputs.allocate((2, slots, 24 if drafting else 8), device=device)
        coordinator = CollectivePreparation(group)
        # Prefill activations reduce in chunks of the rows decode and verification already need a channel for: a
        # channel sized for whole prefill chunks would stage 448 MiB per rank for 4096 rows.
        channel_rows = max(min(max_tokens, REDUCE_ROWS), config.decode_tokens)
        collective = create_all_reduce_runtime(group, device, max_tokens=channel_rows,
            hidden_size=weights.config.hidden, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        vocabulary_collective = create_all_gather_runtime(group, device,
            max_rows=max(config.decode_tokens, slots * (config.draft_tokens or 1)),
            columns=weights.config.vocabulary, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        context_collective = draft_argmax = None
        if drafting:
            context_collective = create_all_gather_runtime(group, device, max_rows=channel_rows,
                columns=weights.config.hidden, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
            # DSpark drafts greedily: each position's head and Markov shards meet in one vocabulary-parallel
            # argmax without gathering both distributions.
            draft_argmax = create_vocabulary_argmax_runtime(group, device,
                local_vocab_size=weights.config.vocabulary // shard.world_size, max_rows=slots,
                ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        # Prefill rows beyond a channel's capacity gather in chunks, as they reduce.
        embedding_collective = create_all_gather_runtime(group, device, max_rows=channel_rows,
            columns=weights.config.hidden, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        router_collective = create_all_gather_runtime(group, device, max_rows=channel_rows,
            columns=2 * shard.world_size * ((weights.config.text["num_experts"] // shard.world_size + 31) // 32 * 32),
            ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        route_collective = (create_route_runtime(group, device, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
                            if shard.world_size > 1 else None)
        context = None
        if config.context_parallel and shard.world_size > 1:
            from .dcp import RECORD_BYTES, ContextParallel, ContextShards

            # Decode and verification gather every rank's absorbed E4M3 query heads and combine latent outputs.
            heads = weights.config.text["num_attention_heads"]
            context = ContextParallel(ContextShards.on(rank, shard.world_size, device),
                heads=create_head_exchange(group, device, max_rows=config.decode_tokens, heads=heads, head_dim=512,
                                           query_head_dim=RECORD_BYTES, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage),
                coordinator=coordinator, peers=pool.share_pages(package_storage, group), slab=None)
        # Every MLA step gathers each rank's query and KV latent rows, padded to 16 bytes: one exchange for up to
        # eight rows, as vLLM's b12x latent transport carries, and one that prefill steps use in chunks.
        text = weights.config.text
        latent = (text["q_lora_rank"] + text["kv_lora_rank"] + text["qk_rope_head_dim"]) // shard.world_size
        latent_runtimes = tuple(create_head_exchange(group, device, max_rows=rows, heads=shard.world_size,
                                                     head_dim=-(-latent // 8) * 8, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
                                for rows in sorted({min(8, max_tokens), channel_rows}))
        identity = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({
            "config": weights.config.text, "headers": headers, "vision": weights.config.vision,
            "draft": None if not drafting else weights.config.draft.raw,
            "world_size": shard.world_size, "contract": "kimi3.graph-inputs.v1"}, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
        session = RecordedPreparationSession(
            compile_workers=config.compile_workers, tuning_replica=config.tuning_replica,
            device=device, checkpoint=identity,
            workload_schema="kimi3", numerical_policy="default", coordinator=coordinator,
            headroom_bytes=config.headroom_bytes, benchmark_storage=package_storage)
        session.__enter__()
        register_benchmark_state(session, pool.reserved_backing, storage=pool.reserved_backing,
                                 restore=pool.clear_for_preparation)
        arena = ScratchArena(device, overlap=config.stream_overlap)
        session.register_scratch(arena)
        graph_buffers = GraphBufferPool(device, chunk_bytes=2 << 20)
        with package_storage.scratch_pool() as scratch_pool:
            # Vision and text graphs execute serially and share disposable workspace.
            text_shape = (max(config.prefill_chunk_size, config.decode_tokens), weights.config.hidden)
            # KDA and MLA layers execute serially and share their attention output.
            text_shapes = (text_shape,) * 4
            if drafting:
                text_shapes += ((text_shape[0], len(weights.config.draft.auxiliary_layers) * text_shape[1]),)
            patches = PATCH_CAPACITIES if config.vision else ()
            cursor = graph_buffers.cursor()
            shared_scratch = cursor.zeros((max(max(patches, default=0) * 3 * weights.config.vision["qkv_hidden_size"],
                sum(rows * columns for rows, columns in text_shapes)),), torch.bfloat16)
            if patches:
                # Reserve the largest vision slabs before smaller text allocations share their chunks.
                VisionScratch.allocate(max(patches), device, work=shared_scratch, buffers=cursor)
                cursor = graph_buffers.cursor()
                shared_scratch = cursor.zeros(shared_scratch.shape, torch.bfloat16)
            activation, total, kda_output, moe_output, *auxiliary = scratch_views(shared_scratch, text_shapes)
            mla_output = kda_output
            prefill_storage = Scratch.allocate(config.prefill_chunk_size, 1, weights.config, shard.world_size, device,
                                               activations=activation[:config.prefill_chunk_size], buffers=cursor)
            decode_storage = Scratch.allocate(config.decode_tokens, config.decode_tokens, weights.config, shard.world_size,
                                              device, buffers=cursor)
            vision_inputs = VisionInputs.allocate(device) if patches else None
            vision_storage = {}
            if context is not None:
                from .dcp import CONTEXT_WINDOW, RECORD_BYTES

                # Serial prefill layers gather their context one window at a time into one slab beside the chunk's
                # own records; it is released while forwards compile.
                window = min(CONTEXT_WINDOW, config.context)
                context = replace(context, window=window, slab=torch.zeros(
                    (window + config.prefill_chunk_size, RECORD_BYTES), dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device=device))
        vision_prefill = vision_state = None
        if patches:
            vision_prefill = PrefillVisionInputs.allocate(config.prefill_chunk_size, device)
            vision_state = VisionState(inputs, vision_prefill, requests, image_slots=config.image_concurrency,
                                       image_token=163605, features=FEATURES, hidden=HIDDEN // shard.world_size)
        vision_buffers = {} if not patches else {**vision_inputs.buffers(), **vision_prefill.buffers()}
        buffers = dict(inputs.buffers(), **vision_buffers, **commands.buffers(),
            **{name: getattr(admission, name) for name in admission.__dataclass_fields__},
            state_pool=pool.backing, memory_capacity=pool.memory_capacity,
            request_pending_token=[REDACTED],
            sampling_grammar_mask=requests.grammar_mask, frame_index=frame,
            submission_sequence=sequence, **completion.buffers())
    forwards, signatures, metadata = {}, {}, {}
    decoder_buffers = DecoderStorage.allocate(weights.config, shard, device, allocator=cursor, scratch={
        "total": total, "kda": {"output": kda_output},
        "mla": {"output": mla_output}, "moe": {"output": moe_output},
        **({"auxiliary": auxiliary[0]} if drafting else {})})
    prefill_sizes, batch_sizes = prefill_capacities(config.prefill_chunk_size), batch_capacities(config.max_active)
    collectives = dict(runtime=collective, embedding_runtime=embedding_collective, router_runtime=router_collective,
        route_runtime=route_collective, vocabulary_runtime=vocabulary_collective, coordinator=coordinator,
        vision_state=vision_state, context=context, latent_runtimes=latent_runtimes)
    speculation = None
    if drafting:
        from .dspark import SpeculativePreparation

        speculation = SpeculativePreparation(weights, pool, requests, inputs, decode_storage, completion=completion,
            frame=frame, sequence=sequence, session=session, workspace=arena, collectives=collectives,
            decoder_buffers=decoder_buffers, draft_tokens=config.draft_tokens, context_runtime=context_collective,
            page_tokens=config.page_tokens, draft_argmax=draft_argmax)
    modes = (True, False) if drafting else (False,)
    count = (len(modes) * (len(prefill_sizes) + 4 * len(batch_sizes)) + len(batch_sizes)
             + len(config.speculative_shapes) + len(patches))
    with phase(progress, "Construct graph catalog", total=count) as stage:
        def add(name, forward, kind, rows, tokens, fields, *, enabled=None):
            forwards[name] = forward
            signatures[name] = GraphSignature(kind, rows, tokens, tuple(fields), speculation_enabled=enabled)
            stage.update(advance=1)

        forward_inputs = (*inputs.buffers(), "sampling_grammar_mask")
        for enabled in modes:
            # Speculative packages also hold plain graphs, selected when Flare loads without drafts.
            mode_weights = weights if enabled else replace(weights, draft=None)
            suffix = "-no-mtp" if drafting and not enabled else ""
            for mode, sizes in (("prefill", reversed(prefill_sizes)), ("decode", () if enabled else reversed(batch_sizes))):
                for capacity in sizes:
                    rows = 1 if mode == "prefill" else capacity
                    name = f"{mode}{capacity}" + (suffix if mode == "prefill" else "")
                    m = metadata[name] = Metadata.allocate(capacity, rows, blocks, device)
                    scratch = (prefill_storage if mode == "prefill" else decode_storage).rows(capacity, rows)
                    decoder = PreparedDecoder(mode_weights, scratch, m, pool, mode=mode,
                        session=session, name=name, workspace=arena, buffers=decoder_buffers, **collectives)
                    batch = PreparedBatch(inputs, requests, m, mode=mode, shard=weights.shard, pool=pool,
                        validate_prefill=vision_state.validate_prefill if mode == "prefill" and patches else None,
                        page_tokens=config.page_tokens)
                    # Plain graphs do not update draft context.
                    forward = PreparedGeneration(decoder, batch, completion, frame, sequence, runtime=collective,
                        coordinator=coordinator, session=session, name=name + ".generation", workspace=arena,
                        context_factory=(None if speculation is None or not enabled
                                         else speculation.forwards.context))
                    add(name, forward, mode, rows, capacity if mode == "prefill" else 1,
                        (*forward_inputs, *(vision_prefill.buffers() if mode == "prefill" and patches else ())),
                        enabled=enabled)
        if speculation is not None:

            for batch, width in sorted(config.speculative_shapes, key=lambda shape: shape[0] * shape[1], reverse=True):

    torch.cuda.synchronize(device)

    from .tokenizer import convert
    frontend_assets = TemporaryDirectory(prefix="flare-kimi3-frontend-")

    eos = weights.config.text["eos_token_id"]

        mapped_host_bytes=0, offloaded_bytes=0, continuation_bytes=pool.backing.nbytes, state_rows=state_rows,
        preparation_state_rows=int(pool.memory_capacity[0].item()),

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PreparationConfig:
    image_concurrency: int | None = None
    compile_workers: int | None = None
    tuning_replica: TuningReplica | None = None
    devices: tuple[int, ...] = tuple(range(8))
    context: int = 1048576
    prefill_chunk_size: int = 4096
    max_active: int = 4
    snapshot_budget_bytes: int = 4 << 30
    headroom_bytes: int = 4 << 30
    compile_decoder: bool = True
    retain_graphs: bool = False
    kernel_cache: Path | None = None
    mtp: bool = True
    speculative_widths: tuple[int, ...] = (1, 2, 3, 4)
    speculative_fixed_width: int | None = None
    speculative_token_capacity: int | None = None
    stream_overlap: bool = True
    expert_scale_compression: str | None = None

    def __post_init__(self):
        from ignition.components.capacity import image_capacity

        object.__setattr__(self, "image_concurrency", image_capacity(self.max_active, self.image_concurrency))
        if self.expert_scale_compression not in (None, "csf"):
            raise ValueError("Step-5 expert scale compression must be None or 'csf'")
        if len(self.devices) not in (4, 8, 16) or len(set(self.devices)) != len(self.devices) or any(d < 0 for d in self.devices):
            raise ValueError("Step-5 preparation requires four, eight, or sixteen distinct GPUs")
        request_capacity(self.max_active)
        if not PAGE_TOKENS <= self.context <= 1048576 or self.context % PAGE_TOKENS:
            raise ValueError("Step-5 context must be 128-aligned in [128,1048576]")
        if not 128 <= self.prefill_chunk_size <= self.context or self.prefill_chunk_size % 128:
            raise ValueError("Step-5 prefill chunk must be 128-aligned and fit the context")
        speculative_shapes(self.max_active, self.speculative_widths, self.speculative_token_capacity)
        if max(self.speculative_widths) > 4:
            raise ValueError("Step-5 MTP supports at most three draft tokens")
        if self.speculative_fixed_width is not None and self.speculative_fixed_width not in self.speculative_widths:
            raise ValueError("fixed verification width must belong to the prepared catalog")
        if self.snapshot_budget_bytes <= 0 or self.headroom_bytes < 0:
            raise ValueError("snapshot budget must be positive and headroom nonnegative")


    @property
    def speculative_shapes(self):
        return (speculative_shapes(self.max_active, self.speculative_widths, self.speculative_token_capacity)
                if self.mtp else ())


@torch.no_grad()
def prepare_rank(snapshot, config, *, rank, group, progress=None, package_storage):
    from .recipe import RECIPE

    snapshot = Path(snapshot).resolve()
    shard = TensorParallelShard(rank, len(config.devices))
    device = torch.device("cuda", config.devices[rank])
    torch.cuda.set_device(device)
    with phase(progress, "Inspect checkpoint"):
        manifest = inspect_indexed_checkpoint(snapshot)
        headers = [s.header_sha256 for s in manifest.shards]
    weights = ModelWeights.load(manifest, device, shard=shard, progress=progress, mtp=config.mtp,
        expert_scale_compression=config.expert_scale_compression, package_storage=package_storage)
    del manifest
    release_unused()
    transient = contextlib.ExitStack()
    transient.enter_context(package_storage.transient())
    layout = continuation_layout(weights.config, shard, mtp=config.mtp)
    snapshots = layout.snapshot_capacity(config.snapshot_budget_bytes)
    if snapshots < 1:
        raise ValueError("snapshot budget must hold one complete Step-5 continuation")
    slots, blocks = request_capacity(config.max_active), config.context // PAGE_TOKENS
    shapes = config.speculative_shapes
    decode_tokens = max((b * w for b, w in shapes), default=slots)
    draft_tokens = max((b * (weights.config.text["num_nextn_predict_layers"] + w) for b, w in shapes), default=slots)
    tokens = max(config.prefill_chunk_size, decode_tokens)
    state_rows, pages = slots + snapshots, config.prefill_chunk_size // PAGE_TOKENS + 2 * slots
    total_memory = minimum_across_ranks(torch.cuda.mem_get_info(device)[1], group)
    with phase(progress, "Allocate model state"):
        pool = ContinuationPool.for_model(weights.config, shard, state_rows + 1, pages, device, mtp=config.mtp,
            storage=package_storage, maximum_pages=total_memory // page_bytes(weights.config, shard),
            maximum_rows=total_memory // layout.row_bytes, backed_slots=min(state_rows + 1, 1 + 2 * slots))
        vocabulary = weights.config.vocabulary
        requests = DeviceRequestState.allocate(device, vocab_size=vocabulary, capacity=slots)
        inputs = BatchInputs.allocate(tokens, blocks, device, capacity=slots)
        admission = AdmissionBuffers.allocate(device, vocab_size=vocabulary, capacity=slots)
        commands = StateCommands.allocate(device, capacity=slots)
        frame = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
        sequence = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
        completion = CompletionOutputs.allocate((2, slots, 24 if config.mtp else 8), device=device)
        coordinator = CollectivePreparation(group)
        collective = create_all_reduce_runtime(group, device, max_tokens=max(decode_tokens, draft_tokens),
            hidden_size=weights.config.hidden, element_bytes=4, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        prefill_collective = create_dma_all_reduce_runtime(group, device, max_tokens=tokens,
            hidden_size=weights.config.hidden, element_bytes=4, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        vision_collective = create_dma_all_reduce_runtime(group, device, max_tokens=PATCH_CAPACITIES[-1],
            hidden_size=1536, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        vocabulary_collective = create_all_gather_runtime(group, device, max_rows=decode_tokens,
            columns=weights.config.vocabulary_partition(shard)[2] * shard.world_size, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        embedding_collective = create_all_gather_runtime(group, device, max_rows=tokens,
            columns=weights.config.hidden, ipc=package_storage.peer_storage)
        identity = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({"config": weights.config.text, "vision": weights.config.vision,
            "quantization": weights.config.quantization, "headers": headers, "world_size": shard.world_size,
            "contract": "step5.graph-inputs.v1"}, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
        session = RecordedPreparationSession(
            compile_workers=config.compile_workers, tuning_replica=config.tuning_replica,
            device=device, checkpoint=identity, workload_schema="step5",
            numerical_policy="default", coordinator=coordinator, headroom_bytes=config.headroom_bytes,
            benchmark_storage=package_storage)
        session.__enter__()
        register_benchmark_state(session, pool.reserved_backing, storage=pool.reserved_backing,
                                 restore=pool.clear_for_preparation)
        arena = ScratchArena(device, overlap=config.stream_overlap)
        session.register_scratch(arena)
        graph_buffers = GraphBufferPool(device, chunk_bytes=2 << 20)
        private_buffers = GraphBufferPool(device, chunk_bytes=2 << 20)
        with package_storage.scratch_pool() as scratch_pool:
            vision_inputs = VisionInputs.allocate(device)
            vision_storage = VisionScratch.allocate(PATCH_CAPACITIES[-1], shard, device, buffers=graph_buffers.cursor())
            prefill_storage = Scratch.allocate(weights.config, shard, config.prefill_chunk_size, 1, config.context,
                                               device, buffers=graph_buffers.cursor())
            decode_storage = Scratch.allocate(weights.config, shard, decode_tokens, decode_tokens, config.context,
                                              device, buffers=graph_buffers.cursor())
            draft_storage = (Scratch.allocate(weights.config, shard, draft_tokens, draft_tokens, config.context,
                                             device, buffers=graph_buffers.cursor()) if config.mtp else None)
        vision_prefill = PrefillVisionInputs.allocate(config.prefill_chunk_size, device)
        vision_state = VisionState(inputs, vision_prefill, requests, image_slots=config.image_concurrency, image_token=128001,
                                   features=FEATURES, hidden=weights.config.hidden // shard.world_size)

            **{name: getattr(admission, name) for name in admission.__dataclass_fields__},
            state_pool=pool.backing, memory_capacity=pool.memory_capacity, request_pending_token=[REDACTED],
            sampling_grammar_mask=requests.grammar_mask, frame_index=frame, submission_sequence=sequence, **completion.buffers())
        collectives = {"runtime": collective, "embedding_runtime": embedding_collective,

        speculation = None

            speculation = SimpleNamespace(weights=weights, pool=pool, inputs=inputs, requests=requests, scratch=decode_storage,

                session=session, workspace=arena, collectives=collectives, overlap=config.stream_overlap,
                completion=completion, frame=frame, sequence=sequence, rng=SpeculativeRngState.allocate(device, capacity=slots),
                offset=torch.zeros(slots, dtype=torch.int64, device=device),
                generation=torch.zeros(slots, dtype=torch.int64, device=device),
                sampling_scratch=None)
    forwards, signatures, metadata = {}, {}, {}
    prefills, batches = prefill_capacities(config.prefill_chunk_size), batch_capacities(config.max_active)
    modes = (True, False) if config.mtp else (False,)
    with phase(progress, "Construct graph catalog"):
        def add(name, forward, kind, rows, tokens, fields, enabled=None):
            forwards[name] = forward
            signatures[name] = GraphSignature(kind, rows, tokens, tuple(fields), speculation_enabled=enabled)

        forward_inputs = (*inputs.buffers(), "sampling_grammar_mask")
        for enabled in modes:
            suffix = "-no-mtp" if config.mtp and not enabled else ""
            mode_weights = weights if enabled else replace(weights, draft=None)
            for mode, sizes in (("prefill", reversed(prefills)), ("decode", () if enabled else reversed(batches))):

                    execution_collectives = dict(collectives, runtime=prefill_collective if mode == "prefill" else collective)
                    decoder = PreparedDecoder(mode_weights, scratch, m, pool, mode=mode, vision=vision_state,

                    batch = PreparedBatch(inputs, requests, m, mode=mode, shard=shard, pool=pool,
                        validate_prefill=vision_state.validate_prefill if mode == "prefill" else None, buffers=private)
                    context = partial(PreparedFeedback, scratch=scratch, vision=vision_state, buffers=private, **execution_collectives)
                    forward = PreparedGeneration(decoder, batch, completion, frame, sequence, runtime=collective,
                        coordinator=coordinator, session=session, name=name + ".generation", workspace=arena,
                        context_factory=context if enabled else None, buffers=private)
                    add(name, forward, mode, rows, capacity if mode == "prefill" else 1,
                        (*forward_inputs, *(vision_prefill.buffers() if mode == "prefill" else ())), enabled)

            encoder = PreparedVision(weights.vision, vision_storage.rows(capacity), vision_inputs, runtime=vision_collective,

            add(name, PreparedVisionGeneration(encoder, vision_state, completion, frame, sequence, buffers=private),
                "vision", 1, capacity, (*vision_inputs.buffers(), "vision_feature_slot"))
        row_inputs = ("request_state_rows", "row_slot_ids", "row_generations", "live_rows")
        for enabled in modes:
            suffix = "-no-mtp" if config.mtp and not enabled else ""
            mode_weights = weights if enabled else replace(weights, draft=None)
            for capacity in reversed(batches):
                name = f"resume{capacity}" + suffix
                forward = PreparedResume(mode_weights, requests, pool, inputs, completion, frame, sequence, rows=capacity,
                    runtime=collective, vocabulary_runtime=vocabulary_collective, coordinator=coordinator,
                    session=session, name=name, buffers=private_buffers.cursor())
                add(name, forward, "resume", capacity, 1, (*row_inputs, "sampling_grammar_mask"), enabled)
                for mode in ("init", "restore", "snapshot"):
                    name = f"{mode}{capacity}" + suffix
                    forward = PreparedMaintenance(mode, requests, pool, commands, inputs, completion, frame, sequence,
                        runtime=collective, coordinator=coordinator, session=session, name=name, capacity=capacity,
                        admission_buffers=admission, draft_state=enabled, buffers=private_buffers.cursor())
                    fields = row_inputs if mode == "snapshot" else ("request_state_rows", *admission.__dataclass_fields__)
                    add(name, forward, mode, capacity, 1, (*fields, "page_tables", *commands.buffers()), enabled)
    with phase(progress, "Prepare and tune kernels") as stage, transient:
        tuning = session.tune(show_progress=progress is not None and rank == 0, console=stage.console)
    stream, graph_pool = torch.cuda.Stream(device=device), package_storage.graph_pool.id
    if config.compile_decoder:

    catalog = {name: forwards[name] for name in (*vision_names, *(name for name in forwards if name not in vision_names))}
    try:
        graphs, compiled = capture_forwards(catalog, signatures, session=session, device=device, stream=stream,
            pool=graph_pool, collective=collective, coordinator=coordinator, compile_decoder=config.compile_decoder,
            progress=progress, cache_root=config.kernel_cache, retain_graphs=config.retain_graphs, materialize=materialize,
            warmup_storage=package_storage, compile_kinds=("prefill", "decode", "resume", "speculative", "vision"))
    finally:

    session.freeze()
    pool.clear_for_preparation()
    torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
    release_unused()
    from .frontend import inference_template

              for role, path in (("tokenizer", snapshot / "tokenizer.json"), ("chat_template", template))}
    frontend = prepare_frontend(snapshot, eos_token_ids=weights.config.text["eos_token_id"])

        "prefill_chunk_size": config.prefill_chunk_size, "pages": pages, "state_rows": state_rows, "snapshots": snapshots,
        "page_tokens": PAGE_TOKENS, "frontend": frontend, "sampling_defaults": RECIPE.sampling_defaults.as_dict(), "assets": assets,
        "model_contract": prepare_contract(signatures, buffers, pool, image_slots=config.image_concurrency, vocabulary=vocabulary, mtp=config.mtp)}
    if config.mtp:
        server_config.update(speculative_widths=config.speculative_widths,
            speculative_fixed_width=config.speculative_fixed_width,
            speculative_token_capacity=speculative_token_capacity(
                config.max_active, max(config.speculative_widths), config.speculative_token_capacity))
    free, total = torch.cuda.mem_get_info(device)
    memory = {"rank": rank, "world_size": shard.world_size, "device": config.devices[rank], "weights_bytes": weights.allocated_bytes,
        "expert_scale_compression": config.expert_scale_compression,
        "mapped_host_bytes": 0, "offloaded_bytes": 0, "continuation_bytes": pool.backing.nbytes, "state_rows": state_rows,
        "preparation_state_rows": int(pool.memory_capacity[0].item()),
        "preparation_state_bytes": int(pool.memory_capacity[0].item()) * layout.row_bytes,
        "pages": pages, "page_bytes": page_bytes(weights.config, shard), "page_tokens": PAGE_TOKENS,
        "kv_bytes": pages * page_bytes(weights.config, shard), "completion_output_bytes": completion.nbytes, "operator_scratch_bytes": arena.nbytes, "graphs": len(graphs),
        "graph_buffer_bytes": graph_buffers.nbytes, "private_buffer_bytes": private_buffers.nbytes,
        "kv_dtype": "float8_e4m3fn",
        "prefill_capacities": prefills, "free_device_bytes": free, "total_device_bytes": total,
        "headroom_bytes": config.headroom_bytes, "tuning": tuning, "compiled_decoder": config.compile_decoder,
        "speculative_shapes": shapes,
        "speculative_token_capacity": server_config.get("speculative_token_capacity", 0)}
    channels = (collective, prefill_collective, vision_collective, vocabulary_collective, embedding_collective)
    disposable = [prefill_storage, decode_storage, vision_storage, arena.tensor, metadata, vision_state.arena,
                  weights.scale_scratch, graph_buffers.chunks, private_buffers.chunks]
    if speculation is not None:
        disposable.append(speculation.sampling_scratch)
    for forward in forwards.values():
        if hasattr(forward, "scratch_tensors"):

        if hasattr(forward, "completion") and hasattr(forward.completion, "scratch_tensors"):

            disposable.append(forward.context.scratch_tensors())
        if hasattr(forward, "encoder"):
            disposable.extend((forward.errors, forward.encoder.scratch_tensors()))
    return PreparedModel(device=config.devices[rank], graphs=graphs, buffers=buffers, signatures=signatures,
        max_active=config.max_active, session=session, server_config=server_config, memory_report=memory,
        export_zero_ranges=(*storage_ranges(disposable), *completion.zero_ranges()),
        resources=(weights, pool, requests, inputs, admission, commands, arena, forwards, prefill_storage,

                   vision_inputs, vision_prefill, vision_state, vision_storage, scratch_pool, graph_buffers, private_buffers, speculation, frontend_assets),

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PreparationConfig:
    image_concurrency: int | None = None
    compile_workers: int | None = None
    tuning_replica: TuningReplica | None = None
    devices: tuple[int, ...] = (0, 1, 2, 3)
    # Device ordinals are host-local when each rank runs on its own Spark.
    hosts: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
    roce_ring: bool = False
    context: int = 1048576
    prefill_chunk_size: int = 4096
    max_active: int = 4
    minimum_pages: int = 8
    # An explicit cache capacity makes memory comparisons independent of automatic sizing.
    kv_pages: int | None = None
    snapshot_budget_bytes: int = 4 << 30
    headroom_bytes: int = 4 << 30
    compile_decoder: bool = True
    retain_graphs: bool = False
    kernel_cache: Path | None = None
    dspark: bool = True
    speculative_widths: tuple[int, ...] = (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)
    speculative_fixed_width: int | None = None
    speculative_token_capacity: int | None = None
    # Run single-row decode's shared expert on an auxiliary stream; without overlap it runs serially.
    stream_overlap: bool = True
    expert_scale_compression: str | None = None
    mla_compute_mode: str = "auto"
    # Separate proposal and verification graphs for native confidence-prefix scheduling.
    split_speculation: bool = False
    packed_verification: bool = False
    # Additional combined graphs for exact qualification; omit when measuring service memory.
    speculation_reference_graphs: bool = False

    def __post_init__(self):
        from ignition.components.capacity import image_capacity
        from ignition.components.compressed_mla import validate_mla_compute_mode

        validate_mla_compute_mode(self.mla_compute_mode)
        object.__setattr__(self, "image_concurrency", image_capacity(self.max_active, self.image_concurrency))
        if self.expert_scale_compression not in (None, "csf"):
            raise ValueError("DeepSeek V4.1 expert scale compression must be None or 'csf'")
        if self.speculation_reference_graphs and not self.split_speculation:
            raise ValueError("speculation reference graphs require split speculation")
        if self.split_speculation and (not self.dspark or self.draft_tokens < 1):
            raise ValueError("split speculation requires a learned draft model and positive draft depth")
        if self.packed_verification and (not self.split_speculation or self.speculative_fixed_width is not None
                                         or self.speculation_reference_graphs):
            raise ValueError("packed verification requires an adaptive retained-proposal catalog")
        if type(self.stream_overlap) is not bool:
            raise TypeError("stream_overlap must be a boolean")
        placements = tuple(zip(self.hosts or ("",) * len(self.devices), self.devices))
        if (not isinstance(self.devices, tuple) or len(self.devices) != 4 or len(set(placements)) != 4
                or self.hosts is not None and (not isinstance(self.hosts, tuple) or len(self.hosts) != 4)
                or any(type(d) is not int or d < 0 for d in self.devices)):
            raise ValueError("DeepSeek V4.1 Flash preparation requires four distinct GPUs")
        if self.roce_ring and self.hosts is None:
            raise ValueError("RoCE ring requires ranks on separate hosts")
        if not PAGE_TOKENS <= self.context <= 1048576 or self.context % PAGE_TOKENS:
            raise ValueError("DeepSeek context must be 128-aligned in [128,1048576]")
        if not 64 <= self.prefill_chunk_size <= self.context or self.prefill_chunk_size % 64:
            raise ValueError("prefill chunk size must be 64-aligned in [64,context]")
        request_capacity(self.max_active)
        self.speculative_shapes
        if self.speculative_fixed_width is not None and self.speculative_fixed_width not in self.speculative_widths:
            raise ValueError("fixed verification width must belong to the prepared widths")
        if self.minimum_pages <= 0 or self.snapshot_budget_bytes <= 0 or self.headroom_bytes < 0:
            raise ValueError("page and snapshot budgets must be positive and headroom nonnegative")
        if self.kv_pages is not None and (type(self.kv_pages) is not int or self.kv_pages < self.minimum_pages):
            raise ValueError("kv_pages must cover the minimum page capacity")

    @property
    def request_capacity(self):
        return request_capacity(self.max_active)

    @property
    def prefill_capacities(self):
        return prefill_capacities(self.prefill_chunk_size)

    @property
    def batch_capacities(self):
        return tuple(reversed(batch_capacities(self.max_active)))

    @property
    def speculative_shapes(self):
        from ignition.components.capacity import speculative_shapes

        return speculative_shapes(self.max_active, self.speculative_widths, self.speculative_token_capacity) if self.dspark else ()

    @property
    def decode_tokens(self):
        return max((b * w for b, w in self.speculative_shapes), default=self.request_capacity)

    @property
    def draft_tokens(self):
        return max(self.speculative_widths) - 1 if self.dspark else 0

    @property
    def all_reduce_tokens(self):
        return max(self.decode_tokens, self.request_capacity * self.draft_tokens,
                   *(capacity for capacity in self.prefill_capacities if capacity < 128))


def _collective_runtimes(config, group, device, *, coordinator, package_storage, verification_samples):
    """Share one RoCE channel across ordered graph collectives on separate hosts."""
    tokens = max(config.prefill_chunk_size, config.decode_tokens, config.request_capacity * config.draft_tokens)
    sample_rows = max(verification_samples, config.request_capacity * config.draft_tokens)
    layouts = ()
    if config.dspark:
        from ignition.components.draft_sampling import PreparedDraftDistribution
        from ignition.components.speculation import SpeculativeAcceptance

        batch = max(config.batch_capacities)
        layouts = (SpeculativeAcceptance.storage_layout(batch, max(config.speculative_widths)),)
        if config.draft_tokens:
            layouts += (PreparedDraftDistribution.broadcast_layout(batch),)
    if coordinator.spans_hosts:
        from ignition.components.collectives import packed_broadcast_layout

        # Vocabulary partitions and packed sampling results use the same serial gather channel.
        result_bytes = max((packed_broadcast_layout(layout.values())[1] for layout in layouts), default=0)
        gather_bytes = max(sample_rows * (129280 // len(config.devices)) * 2,
                           (result_bytes + 15) // 16 * 16)
        decode_tokens = config.all_reduce_tokens
        runtime = create_roce_runtime(group, device, max_tokens=decode_tokens, pipe_tokens=tokens,
            hidden_size=5120, gather_bytes=gather_bytes, ring=config.roce_ring, package_storage=package_storage)
        return runtime, runtime, runtime, runtime if layouts else None
    ipc = package_storage.peer_storage
    collective = create_all_reduce_runtime(group, device, max_tokens=config.all_reduce_tokens, hidden_size=5120, ipc=ipc)
    prefill = create_dma_all_reduce_runtime(group, device,
        max_tokens=config.prefill_chunk_size, hidden_size=5120, ipc=ipc)
    vocabulary = create_all_gather_runtime(group, device, max_rows=sample_rows, columns=129280, ipc=ipc)
    result = create_result_broadcast_runtime(group, device, layouts=layouts, ipc=ipc) if layouts else None
    return collective, prefill, vocabulary, result


@torch.no_grad()
def prepare_rank(snapshot, config, *, rank, group, progress=None, package_storage=None):
    if package_storage is None:
        raise ValueError("DeepSeek preparation requires package storage")
    snapshot = Path(snapshot).resolve()
    shard = TensorParallelShard(rank, len(config.devices))
    device = torch.device("cuda", config.devices[rank])
    torch.cuda.set_device(device)
    with phase(progress, "Inspect checkpoint"):
        manifest = inspect_indexed_checkpoint(snapshot)
    metadata_path = manifest.metadata_path
    transient = contextlib.ExitStack()
    transient.enter_context(package_storage.transient())
    weights = ModelWeights.load(manifest, device, shard=shard, progress=progress, dspark=config.dspark,
                                confidence=config.split_speculation,
                                expert_scale_compression=config.expert_scale_compression)
    release_unused()
    if progress is not None:
        progress(f"Resident model tensors: {weights.allocated_bytes / (1 << 30):.3f} GiB per rank")
    sequence = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
    tables = Tables.prepare(manifest, weights.config, tokens=max(config.prefill_chunk_size, config.decode_tokens),
        device=device, sequence=sequence, host_allocator=package_storage.host_allocate, progress=progress, shard=shard)
    with phase(progress, "Allocate model state and collectives"):
        layout = continuation_layout(weights.config, dspark=config.dspark)
        snapshots = layout.snapshot_capacity(config.snapshot_budget_bytes)
        if snapshots < 1:
            raise ValueError("snapshot budget must hold a complete DeepSeek continuation")
        slots, blocks = config.request_capacity, config.context // PAGE_TOKENS
        execution_rows = slots * (max(config.speculative_widths) if config.dspark else 1)
        state_rows = snapshots + execution_rows
        pages = (config.prefill_chunk_size + PAGE_TOKENS - 1) // PAGE_TOKENS + 2 * slots
        if config.kv_pages is not None:
            pages = config.kv_pages
        bytes_per_page = page_bytes(weights.config)
        total_memory = virtual_device_memory(device, group, tuning_replica=config.tuning_replica)
        pool = ContinuationPool.allocate(weights.config, state_rows + 1, pages, device,
            storage=package_storage, maximum_pages=total_memory // bytes_per_page,
            maximum_rows=total_memory // layout.row_bytes,
            backed_slots=min(state_rows + 1, 1 + execution_rows + slots), dspark=config.dspark)
        requests = DeviceRequestState.allocate(device, vocab_size=129280, capacity=slots)
        inputs = BatchInputs.allocate(config.prefill_chunk_size, blocks, device, capacity=slots)
        admission = AdmissionBuffers.allocate(device, vocab_size=129280, capacity=slots)
        commands = StateCommands.allocate(device, capacity=slots)
        frame = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
        completion = CompletionOutputs.allocate((2, slots, 24 if config.dspark else 8), device=device)
        coordinator = CollectivePreparation(group)
        verification_samples = (slots * max(config.speculative_widths)
                                if config.packed_verification else config.decode_tokens)
        collective, prefill_collective, vocabulary_collective, result_collective = _collective_runtimes(
            config, group, device, coordinator=coordinator, package_storage=package_storage,
            verification_samples=verification_samples)
        identity = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({"config": json.loads((metadata_path / "config.json").read_text()),
            "headers": [s.header_sha256 for s in manifest.shards], "world_size": shard.world_size,
            "contract": "deepseek41.graph-inputs.v1"}, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
        session = RecordedPreparationSession(
            compile_workers=config.compile_workers, tuning_replica=config.tuning_replica,
            device=device, checkpoint=identity,
            workload_schema="deepseek41-text", numerical_policy="default", coordinator=coordinator,
            headroom_bytes=config.headroom_bytes, benchmark_storage=package_storage)
        session.__enter__()
        session.register_benchmark_resource("continuations", pool, restore=pool.clear_for_preparation)
        arena = ScratchArena(device, overlap=config.stream_overlap)
        session.register_scratch(arena)
        graph_buffers = GraphBufferPool(device, chunk_bytes=2 << 20)
        activation_buffers = GraphBufferPool(device, chunk_bytes=2 << 20)
        candidate_tokens = config.prefill_chunk_size
        if (weights.config.decoder_start is not None
                and weights.config.text["candidate_source_layer_id"] >= weights.config.decoder_start):
            candidate_tokens = min(candidate_tokens, 128)
        prefill_storage = Scratch.allocate(config.prefill_chunk_size, 1, shard.world_size, device,
            buffers=activation_buffers.cursor(), candidate_tokens=candidate_tokens)
        # The suffix boundary gathers from the full prefill into disjoint destinations.
        suffix_storage = Scratch.allocate(128, 1, shard.world_size, device, buffers=prefill_storage.buffers)
        decoder_storage = Scratch.allocate(config.decode_tokens, verification_samples, shard.world_size, device,
            buffers=activation_buffers.cursor())
        window_staging = (decoder_storage.buffers.zeros(
            (len(weights.layers), slots, (128 + max(config.speculative_widths)) * 528), torch.uint8)
            if config.dspark else None)
        vision_state = vision_inputs = vision_prefill = vision_storage = None
        if weights.vision is not None:
            vision_inputs = VisionInputs.allocate(device, patches=max(PATCH_CAPACITIES))
            vision_prefill = PrefillVisionInputs.allocate(config.prefill_chunk_size, device)
            vision_state = VisionState(weights.vision, inputs, vision_prefill, requests, features=4096,
                token_base=129280, sentinel_names=("image_start", "image_start", "image_newline", "image_end"),
                feature_type=1, image_slots=config.image_concurrency)
            vision_storage = {}
        decoder_factory, draft_factory = _forward_factories(config.mla_compute_mode,
            window_staging=window_staging, suffix_scratch=suffix_storage, vision=vision_state)
        buffers = dict(inputs.buffers(), **tables.buffers(), **commands.buffers(), **{
            name: getattr(admission, name) for name in admission.__dataclass_fields__},
            state_pool=pool.backing, memory_capacity=pool.memory_capacity,
            sampling_grammar_mask=requests.grammar_mask, frame_index=frame,
            submission_sequence=sequence, **completion.buffers())
        if vision_state is not None:
            buffers.update(vision_inputs.buffers(), **vision_prefill.buffers())
        forwards, signatures, metadata, scratch = {}, {}, {}, {}
        speculation = None
        if config.dspark:
            from ignition.components.dspark import DSparkForwards, SpeculativePreparation

            speculation = SpeculativePreparation(weights, tables, pool, requests, inputs, decoder_storage,
                draft_tokens=config.draft_tokens, completion=completion, frame=frame, sequence=sequence,
                session=session, workspace=arena,
                runtime=collective, vocabulary_runtime=vocabulary_collective,
                markov_runtime=None, coordinator=coordinator, result_runtime=result_collective,
                buffers=activation_buffers.cursor(),
                forwards=DSparkForwards(decoder_factory, Scratch, _CONTEXT,
                    draft_factory, PreparedMarkov))

    del manifest
    modes = (True, False) if config.dspark else (False,)
    count = (len(modes) * (len(config.prefill_capacities) + 4 * len(config.batch_capacities))
             + len(config.speculative_shapes) + len(config.batch_capacities))
    if config.split_speculation:
        count += len(config.batch_capacities) * (config.draft_tokens + 1)
        if config.speculation_reference_graphs:
            count += len(config.speculative_shapes)
    count += len(PATCH_CAPACITIES) if vision_state is not None else 0
    catalog_bytes = {}
    catalog_previous = torch.cuda.memory_allocated(device)
    with phase(progress, "Construct graph catalog", total=count) as stage:
        def add(name, forward, kind, rows, tokens, fields, *, enabled=None, packed_tokens=0):
            nonlocal catalog_previous
            forwards[name] = forward
            signatures[name] = GraphSignature(kind, rows, tokens, tuple(fields), speculation_enabled=enabled,
                                              packed_token_capacity=packed_tokens)
            allocated = torch.cuda.memory_allocated(device)
            catalog_bytes[kind] = catalog_bytes.get(kind, 0) + allocated - catalog_previous
            catalog_previous = allocated
            stage.update(advance=1)

        forward_inputs = (*inputs.buffers(), "sampling_grammar_mask")
        for enabled in modes:
            suffix = "-no-mtp" if config.dspark and not enabled else ""
            mode_weights = weights if enabled else replace(weights, draft=None)
            for mode, capacities in (("prefill", reversed(config.prefill_capacities)),
                                     ("decode", () if enabled else config.batch_capacities)):
                for capacity in capacities:
                    rows = 1 if mode == "prefill" else capacity
                    name = f"{mode}{capacity}" + (suffix if mode == "prefill" else "")
                    cursor = graph_buffers.cursor()
                    metadata[name] = Metadata.allocate(capacity, rows, blocks, device, buffers=cursor)
                    storage = prefill_storage if mode == "prefill" else decoder_storage
                    scratch[name] = storage.rows(capacity, rows)
                    decoder = decoder_factory(mode_weights, tables, scratch[name], metadata[name], pool,
                        mode=mode, runtime=prefill_collective if mode == "prefill" and capacity >= 128 else collective,
                        vocabulary_runtime=vocabulary_collective,
                        coordinator=coordinator, session=session, name=name, workspace=arena)
                    batch = PreparedBatch(inputs, requests, metadata[name], mode=mode, shard=shard, pool=pool,
                        input_vocabulary=INPUT_VOCABULARY if vision_state is not None else None,
                        validate_prefill=vision_state.validate_prefill if vision_state is not None and mode == "prefill" else None,
                        buffers=cursor)
                    forward = PreparedGeneration(decoder, batch, completion, frame, sequence, runtime=collective,
                        coordinator=coordinator, session=session, name=name + ".generation", workspace=arena,
                        context_factory=_CONTEXT, buffers=cursor)
                    fields = (*forward_inputs, "vision_token_indices", "vision_feature_slot") if mode == "prefill" and vision_state is not None else forward_inputs
                    add(name, forward, mode, rows, capacity if mode == "prefill" else 1, fields, enabled=enabled)
        split = None
        if speculation is not None:
            from ignition.components.parallel_draft import PreparedParallelDraftRound
            speculation.sampling_buffers = graph_buffers
            if config.split_speculation:
                from copy import copy
                from ignition.components.capacity import proposal_shapes
                from ignition.components.split_draft import (
                    PreparedCombinedDraftRound, PreparedDraftProposal, PreparedDraftVerification, PreparedProposalStorage)

                confidence = package_storage.host_allocate("proposal_confidence", (slots, config.draft_tokens), torch.float32)
                buffers["proposal_confidence"] = confidence.device_view
                split = PreparedProposalStorage(speculation, config.draft_tokens)
                buffers.update(split.buffers())
                proposals = {}
                for batch, depth in sorted(proposal_shapes(config.max_active, config.draft_tokens), reverse=True):
                    owner = copy(speculation)
                    owner.block_size = depth
                    name = f"proposal{batch}x{depth + 1}"
                    source = PreparedParallelDraftRound(owner, batch, depth + 1, name,
                        buffers=speculation.sampling_buffers.cursor(), proposal_only=True)
                    source.prepare()
                    proposal = PreparedDraftProposal(source, confidence.device_view, split)
                    proposals[batch, depth] = proposal
                    add(name, proposal, "proposal", batch, depth + 1, forward_inputs, enabled=True)
                for batch, width in sorted(config.speculative_shapes, key=lambda shape: shape[0] * shape[1], reverse=True):
                    name = f"verification{batch}x{width}"
                    logical_width = max(config.speculative_widths) if config.packed_verification else width
                    packed_tokens = batch * width if config.packed_verification else 0
                    if packed_tokens:
                        name = f"verification{batch}x{logical_width}-tokens{packed_tokens}"
                    target = PreparedParallelDraftRound(speculation, batch, logical_width, name,
                        generate_proposals=False, buffers=speculation.sampling_buffers.cursor(),
                        target_token_capacity=packed_tokens or None)
                    target.prepare()
                    verification = PreparedDraftVerification(split, target)
                    add(name, verification, "verification", batch, logical_width, forward_inputs, enabled=True,
                        packed_tokens=packed_tokens)
                    if width == 1:
                        # No proposal is needed to decode while retaining draft context.
                        decode = PreparedParallelDraftRound(speculation, batch, 1, f"speculative{batch}x1",
                            buffers=speculation.sampling_buffers.cursor())
                        decode.prepare()
                        add(f"speculative{batch}x1", decode, "speculative", batch, 1, forward_inputs, enabled=True)
                    if config.speculation_reference_graphs:
                        add(f"combined{batch}x{width}", PreparedCombinedDraftRound(
                            proposals[batch, config.draft_tokens], verification),

            else:

                        buffers=speculation.sampling_buffers.cursor())

        if vision_state is not None:
            for capacity in reversed(PATCH_CAPACITIES):

        progress=progress, cache_root=config.kernel_cache, retain_graphs=config.retain_graphs,
        materialize=pool.clear_for_preparation, warmup_storage=package_storage,
        compile_kinds=("prefill", "decode", "resume", "speculative", "proposal", "verification", "vision"))
    session.freeze()
    pool.clear_for_preparation()
    if split is not None:

    torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
